title: Wikipedia Research Toolkit: Usage Guide
purpose: Complete instructions for using wikipedia_tools.py (SCR-0043) to extract links, metadata, and citations from Wikipedia articles via DBpedia SPARQL.

commands.returns: Description, categories, link counts, top citation domains, see-also articles

commands.use_case: Get all links for all 234 articles
commands.returns: Per-article link counts. First run: ~58s. Cached: 42ms
Categories, descriptions, labels. First run: ~8min. Cached: instant
Newline format with compressed URLs. ~31% fewer tokens than JSON

examples.use_case: Get external citation links for one article
Get internal wiki links for one article

examples.code:
meta = wt.get_metadata('Game_theory')
# Returns: {'categories': ['Artificial_intelligence', 'Game_theory', ...], 'description': 'branch of mathematics...', 'label': 'Game theory', 'seeAlso': [...], 'hypernym': ''}

titles = wt.get_all_titles()
data = wt.batch_links(titles, link_type='both')
meta = wt.batch_metadata(titles)

llm_text = wt.export_llm(data, meta=meta)
# ~31% fewer tokens than JSON

links.description: Get external + internal links for one article. Returns JSON.

metadata.description: Get categories, description, seeAlso, label, hypernym. Returns JSON.

batch.description: Batch process articles from category-pages.json. Prints per-article summary.

options.--limit: Process only first N articles (default: all 234)

batch-meta.description: Batch fetch metadata for all articles.

summary.description: Rich overview: description, categories, link counts, top domains, seeAlso.

export.description: Export all cached data. Use 'llm' for agent prompts, 'compact' for storage, 'full' for debugging.

stats.description: Show cache counts and session statistics.

clear-cache.description: Delete all cached data. Next queries will hit DBpedia fresh.

data_coverage.title: Current Data Coverage (as of 2026-03-12)
known_gaps: ChatGPT, recent AI companies have 0 links
External links heavily skewed toward major articles (AI=200, most others=0-15)
No article body text available (dbo:abstract not on public endpoint)
No citation context (which claim each URL supports)
data_coverage.gap_filling_strategy: Use WebSearch for articles missing from DBpedia. See KB-0045 Pass 2.

url_compression_reference.title: URL Prefix Compression Table
url_compression_reference.description: Used in LLM and compact exports. Lossless — use decompress_url() to restore.

troubleshooting.empty_results: Article may not exist in DBpedia. Try WebSearch as fallback.
troubleshooting.sparql_timeout: Reduce batch size. Metadata queries are heavier than link queries.
troubleshooting.special_chars_in_title: Tool handles / : ? automatically via _cache_safe(). If new chars appear, add to the method.
troubleshooting.redirect_noise: Tool filters results to only requested titles. If you see unexpected articles, it's a DBpedia redirect — the original article name is likely a redirect.

procedures: Use quick_start commands for common operations (summary, batch, batch-meta, export, stats)
Import WikipediaTools class for Python API usage in agent scripts
Refer to cli_reference for full CLI command syntax
Check data_coverage for known gaps and gap-filling strategies
Use url_compression_reference to decode compressed URLs in exports
